title: All keyboard input in editor stops working
body:
### Tested versions

v4.7.2.stable.mono.official [ed1daf0bf]

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable.mono - Linux Mint 21.3 (Virginia) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors (note: it's 2 monitors and a graphics tablet) - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (nvidia; 580.173.02) - AMD Ryzen 5 5500 (12 threads) - 15.50 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Several times a day all keyboard input suddenly stops working (including function keys, arrow keys, shortcuts, etc.) and I have to restart Godot to make it work again. All other programs work fine. I use Codium for scripts, and I *think* it happens when I'm alt-tabbing between Codium and Godot\*, but I can't figure out what exactly is causing it or how to reproduce it.

I found this similar issue https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/85664, but I'm not sure it's related. 1) for me it happens in the entire editor, not just the script editor, and 2) I don't have ibus installed at all.

I tried running Godot with --verbose and waiting until it happens again but there wasn't anything unusual in the log, only "Accessibility: window 47 adapter created." and similar messages.

---
Something slightly different happened just now: instead of input not working at all, shortcuts _do_ work, I can't type at all in most textboxes ("Filter nodes", "Filter messages", seemingly any field that takes a string with the exception of renaming nodes), I CAN type in fields that take numbers (e.g. "Position", "Scale", "Layer") BUT I can only type one symbol before input in that specific field stops working. If I left-click to move the caret while renaming a node, that also makes keyboard input for that field stop working:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cce129f5-919a-414e-9344-88e0a8f5325a

\*This happened while I was in the middle of typing in Godot and Codium was closed, so my theory about it being related to alt-tabbing/Codium is probably wrong. Again input in all other apps works fine and it fixed itself after I restarted Godot.

### Steps to reproduce

I wish I knew!

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Happens in all my projects, they all use Forward+ if that's relevant
